provenance.sourceEntryOriginal: - **426.** Day-to-day emotional wellbeing seemed to plateau around $75,000 income (Kahneman & Deaton, 2010); a joint reanalysis found it keeps rising for most people, plateauing only for the least happy 20% (Killingsworth, Kahneman & Mellers, 2023).
